title: PhysRF-WorldJEPA: Transforming Heterogeneous Large Language Models into Manifold-Decoupled Millimeter-Wave Radar World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32113v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving, all-weather physical scene understanding across darkness, smoke, and walls. However, standard instruction tuning treats continuous radar streams as static text-like tokens, causing near-random global radar-to-text retrieval and severe physical drift under sensor blackouts. Conversely, coupling pairwise contrastive losses (e.g., SigLIP) directly into the shared backbone improves retrieval but injects $O(B^2)$ repulsive gradients that fracture continuous coordinate manifolds ($R^2 < 0$). We present PhysRF-WorldJEPA, a manifold-decoupled Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) that separates continuous electromagnetic state prediction from cross-modal language alignment. translated_title: PhysRF-WorldJEPA：将异构大语言模型转变为流形解耦的毫米波雷达世界模型
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）适配到毫米波（mmWave）雷达上，可实现跨黑暗、烟雾和墙壁的隐私保护、全天候物理场景理解。然而，标准的指令微调将连续的雷达数据流视为静态的类文本标记，导致近乎随机的全局雷达-文本检索，以及在传感器黑障情况下的严重物理漂移。反之，将成对对比损失（如SigLIP）直接耦合到共享骨干网络中虽然改善了检索效果，但会注入O(B²)的排斥性梯度，破坏连续坐标流形（R² < 0）。我们提出了PhysRF-WorldJEPA，这是一种流形解耦的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），将连续电磁状态预测与跨模态语言对齐分离开来。一个无衰减的1.0倍时钟锚点与并行双尺度射频编码器共同为经过两步状态空间EMA-JEPA（去噪->推演）训练的精简约3% LoRA大语言模型提供输入，并采用采样……
tldr: 提出PhysRF-WorldJEPA，一种流形解耦的联合嵌入预测架构，通过将连续电磁状态预测与跨模态语言对齐分离，使大语言模型能够基于毫米波雷达实现全天候、隐私保护的物理场景理解。
en_tdlr: PhysRF-WorldJEPA is proposed, a manifold-decoupled Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture that separates continuous electromagnetic state prediction from cross-modal language alignment, enabling LLMs to achieve all-weather, privacy-preserving physical scene understanding from millimeter-wave radar.
